choices: Analyze the primary, all-items E-023 run only; retain all items, including coding-fail_moderate-6021. Secondary analyses, sensitivities, and model interactions are outside the requested output.

Restrict material seeds to 6000–6023 and ignore other seeds. Expect 12 distinct item IDs per seed, as implied by 288 items over 24 seeds. A seed is complete only if all 12 items have all eight cells with Boolean verdicts.
Use the final physical line for each (seed, item ID, cell), even if its verdict is missing or invalid. Only JSON true and false are valid verdicts.

Use cell names as the factor encoding and reject contradictory redundant SP/ZU/AU fields. Reject inconsistent truth or primary metadata across retained cells of an item; do not infer or repair metadata.
Do not pool different models. Reject multiple model names in the retained main-run records; a single model name is treated as the supplied run.
Sort items by (seed, item ID) before resampling. Resample items independently with replacement, not seeds or individual judgments.

For V1 use broken items with primary=true; for V2 use all broken items; for V3 use all items, including working items. Average each factor level equally over its other eligible cells before taking level 1 minus level 0.

Use 5000 ordinary bootstrap draws and independent Python random.Random streams: 201 for V1 CI, 202 for V2 CI, 203 for V3 CI, and 211/212 for V1/V2 bootstrap tests. The preregistration does not explicitly map V3 to a start value; choose 203.
Compute percentile endpoints by linear interpolation at (B-1)*p in the sorted bootstrap estimates, for p=0.025 and p=0.975.

The preregistration does not define the p-values needed for BH. Use two-sided, null-centered nonparametric bootstrap tests: count draws with |bootstrap mean - observed mean| >= |observed mean|, with add-one correction (count+1)/(5000+1). Apply standard BH adjustment jointly to V1 and V2 only.

The decision-rule labels overlap. Give priority to 'praktisch null', then 'Vorhersage widerlegt', then 'Vorhersage gestützt', otherwise 'nicht entschieden'. Practical null is the stated upper-bound criterion, not a two-sided equivalence claim; estimates and intervals retain direction.

Use 'nur deskriptiv' for V1/V2 when fewer than 16 seeds are complete. For E-023 also use that label if mean run_check use at ZU=1 is below 1 or any cell has more than 5% missing verdicts. Continue reporting estimates and intervals in these cases.
For the E-023 technical gates, use all planned main-run trials after deduplication: absent trials contribute zero run_check calls and count as missing verdicts. Each cell has 24*12 planned trials.
No numerical threshold defines 'misses almost everything'; do not invent a floor-effect cutoff or automatically suppress inference for that reason.
Compute miss and false-alarm rates from complete seeds only, on all broken and all working items respectively. Return null for an empty denominator or unavailable estimate/interval.
Do not make discretionary ground-truth exclusions: raw judgments alone cannot establish the manual generator-error exclusion criterion.
